easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have a card in hand.
description:
Activate Jadzi by discarding a card.
Necropotence triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz.
Repeat.
Resolve all Jadzi abilities.

uses.name: Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios // Journey to the Oracle
